evidence_required: FT-011-AC-008 RED: the Calibration detail flow cannot invoke the existing selected promotion or whole-subset deletion operations; GREEN: separately confirmed developer actions resolve the selected current evidence server-side, promote only the curated NFR-DATA-03 subset, preserve it through ordinary cleanup and delete the whole subset idempotently; decisive comparison: disposable selected/unselected evidence is inspected before promotion, after ordinary cleanup, after explicit deletion and after one safe repeat, including denied/unconfirmed requests and forbidden-payload absence; artifact: redacted application/destructive output under .tasks/TASK-106-T3-FT-011-W4/.
purpose: Expose only the two developer actions needed to retain and later delete one curated Calibration case through the existing diagnostics owner operations.
success_outcome: A separately confirmed developer can promote only a selected curated subset, ordinary cleanup preserves it, and a separately confirmed repeated whole-subset deletion safely removes it.
anti_goals: Do not implement ordinary Calibration-run retention or change its cleanup selection/result.
Do not add a promotion route, archive/history table or retain the whole run, unselected evidence, screenshots, logs, credentials, sessions, embeddings or object-store keys.
Do not delete promo-owned rows directly, restore ordinary data or touch production/operator state.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL/MinIO, operator/default Attempts/evidence/runs and real participant names
Ordinary run cleanup implementation, direct diagnostics deletion of promo rows and ownership-crossing cascades
New route, scheduler/timer/history/archive state and unrelated serving or retention behavior
stop_conditions: Promotion/delete cannot reuse the existing Calibration detail POST and diagnostic_evidence promoted_subset operations.
The curated case cannot survive ordinary cleanup without retaining extra data or changing ordinary lifetimes.
T3 action/deletion probes cannot use disposable synthetic state, one safe repeat, redacted artifacts and complete cleanup.

constraints: Expose promote and delete_promoted only as exact confirmed actions through POST /staff/calibrations/{calibration_id}; reuse TASK-104 authorization, CSRF and failure mapping without a new route.
Resolve selected current evidence and annotations server-side, then call the existing diagnostics-owned promoted_subset and idempotent whole-subset deletion operations.
Use disposable selected/unselected evidence with synthetic names, denied/unconfirmed cases, one safe repeated delete and complete task-owned cleanup.
invariants: Promotion preserves only the selected currently available NFR-DATA-03 subset and never extends ordinary run/evidence/annotation/log lifetime.
Whole-subset deletion is idempotent, clears promoted_subset plus promoted_at together and never restores ordinary data.
Only diagnostics writes its promoted representation; no cascade or direct foreign write crosses ownership.
verification_targets: Application fixtures prove current-developer plus matching-confirmation success and unauthenticated/wrong-role/revoked/CSRF/unconfirmed/invalid selection denial without mutation or existence disclosure.
Selected/unselected fixtures prove only curated fields enter promoted_subset, ordinary cleanup preserves them, and explicit whole-subset deletion plus one repeat clears them without restoration.
Ownership and payload inspection proves reuse of the existing detail route and owner operations with no direct promo delete, extra route, archive/history model or forbidden retained data.
